svg.title: RES-496 Olympic pulls: bar velocity, bar height and foot force
svg.desc: Bar vertical velocity (blue), bar height above the floor position (green) and summed foot force over system weight (orange), with latent lift-off and second-pull-end markers.
svg.text: RES-496 Olympic pulls: bar velocity, bar height and foot force
Synthetic only. Joint phases (double knee bend, triple extension) are not identifiable from FORCE/LPT.
